patterns.message: Pure packages never import react, react-native, expo, electron or node:*; use a port from @elv/domain (spec section 5.2).

deniedGlobals.window: Pure packages run on non-browser runtimes (Hermes, Node); use a port from @elv/domain instead of browser globals.
